title: ocotea florulenta
intro: Ocotea florulenta, commonly known as "Palo Amarillo," is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest, belonging to the family Lauraceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, and is said to support immune function, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Ocotea florulenta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonoids, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes. The plant's bioactive compounds have been shown to have neuroprotective, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressant effects, making it a popular ingredient in natural health supplements.
